mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is literature-contextual; no direct membrane permeabilization experiment was performed in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Increased cationicity/amphipathicity of the analogues is associated with broader antimicrobial activity and acquired antiproliferative activity.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Association is source-supported; it is not a molecular target mechanism.
